mapper.sql: select m.med_id, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.trade_name, m.med_spec, m.unit, c.category_name, m.manufacturer, m.approval_no, m.storage_cond, ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) as stock_qty, greatest(ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) - ifnull(st.lock_qty, 0), 0) as available_qty, m.stock_min, m.stock_max, case when ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) < m.stock_min then '库存不足' when m.stock_max > 0 and ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) > m.stock_max then '库存积压' else '正常' end as stock_status from med_info m left join med_category c on c.category_id = m.category_id left join med_stock st on st.med_id = m.med_id
mapper.select: select m.med_id, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit, b.batch_no, b.expire_date, datediff(b.expire_date, curdate()) as remain_days, b.remain_qty, s.supplier_name from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id left join med_supplier s on s.supplier_id = b.supplier_id where m.status = '0' and b.remain_qty > 0 and b.expire_date >= curdate() and b.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval #{days} day) order by b.expire_date, m.med_id, b.batch_id limit #{limit}

select (select count(*) from med_info where status = '0') as medicine_count, (select ifnull(sum(st.total_qty), 0) from med_stock st inner join med_info m on m.med_id = st.med_id where m.status = '0') as stock_qty, (select count(*) from med_info m left join med_stock st on st.med_id = m.med_id where m.status = '0' and ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) < m.stock_min) as low_stock_count, (select count(*) from med_info m left join med_stock st on st.med_id = m.med_id where m.status = '0' and m.stock_max > 0 and ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) > m.stock_max) as overstock_count, (select count(*) from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id where m.status = '0' and b.remain_qty > 0 and b.expire_date >= curdate() and b.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval m.warn_days day)) as expiring_batch_count, (select count(*) from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id where m.status = '0' and b.remain_qty > 0 and b.expire_date < curdate()) as expired_batch_count

select m.med_id, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit, ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) as current_qty, greatest(ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) - ifnull(st.lock_qty, 0), 0) as available_qty, ifnull(m.stock_min, 0) as stock_min, ifnull(m.stock_max, 0) as stock_max, ifnull(outflow.outbound_qty_30d, 0) as outbound_qty_30d from med_info m left join med_stock st on st.med_id = m.med_id left join ( select med_id, sum(-change_qty) as outbound_qty_30d from med_stock_flow where flow_type = '2' and change_qty < 0 and flow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by med_id ) outflow on outflow.med_id = m.med_id where m.status = '0' order by (greatest(ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) - ifnull(st.lock_qty, 0), 0) < ifnull(m.stock_min, 0)) desc, ifnull(outflow.outbound_qty_30d, 0) desc, m.med_id limit #{limit}

select ifnull(sum(case when f.flow_type = '1' and f.change_qty > 0 then f.change_qty else 0 end), 0) as inbound_qty, ifnull(sum(case when f.flow_type = '2' and f.change_qty < 0 then -f.change_qty else 0 end), 0) as outbound_qty, ifnull(sum(case when f.flow_type = '3' and f.change_qty > 0 then f.change_qty else 0 end), 0) as return_qty, ifnull(sum(case when f.flow_type = '4' then f.change_qty else 0 end), 0) as adjustment_net_qty, ifnull(sum(case when f.flow_type = '5' and f.change_qty < 0 then -f.change_qty else 0 end), 0) as expired_clean_qty, count(f.flow_id) as movement_count, (select count(*) from med_info m left join med_stock st on st.med_id = m.med_id where m.status = '0' and greatest(ifnull(st.total_qty, 0) - ifnull(st.lock_qty, 0), 0) < ifnull(m.stock_min, 0)) as low_stock_count, (select count(*) from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id where m.status = '0' and b.remain_qty > 0 and b.expire_date >= curdate() and b.expire_date <= date_add(curdate(), interval m.warn_days day)) as expiring_batch_count, (select count(*) from med_stock_batch b inner join med_info m on m.med_id = b.med_id where m.status = '0' and b.remain_qty > 0 and b.expire_date < curdate()) as expired_batch_count from med_stock_flow f where f.flow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)

select m.med_id, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit, sum(-f.change_qty) as outbound_qty, count(*) as outbound_transactions from med_stock_flow f inner join med_info m on m.med_id = f.med_id where m.status = '0' and f.flow_type = '2' and f.change_qty < 0 and f.flow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by m.med_id, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit order by outbound_qty desc, m.med_id limit #{limit}
